light_description: Japanese handmade high-gain drive pedal designed to preserve picking nuance, with 3-band EQ, BITE mode and Plexi switching.
Japanese handmade drive with Drive and Preamp modes, bright switching and the JACKAL high-gain family voicing.
JACKAL MIDNIGHT variant adding clean blend, clean low-pass filtering and clean volume controls for retaining low-end and attack.
Limetone Audio prototype-range fuzz/drive product retained as a named builder product state rather than merged into JACKAL.
Japanese handmade drive pedal with OD1, OD2 and DIST modes plus wide-range three-band EQ and selectable bypass behavior.
Japanese handmade fuzz whose later model change expanded the range from distortion-box textures to compressed fuzz sounds.
Japanese handmade bass overdrive designed to retain low-end definition with Drive, Treble, Bass and Volume controls.
Japanese handmade high-gain distortion documented in the current A.Y.A Tokyo Japan dealer catalog alongside DRIVESTA and BM-FUZZ.
Japanese handmade vintage-oriented overdrive developed by builder Shinichi Suzuki and voiced as a contemporary take on classic Japanese drive.
Japanese handmade overdrive with gain-boost switching, positioned by the builder as a pedalized classic amp-drive voice.
Japanese Shin's Music drive/preamp model documented in current retail and builder channels; preserve as a named product state within the DUMBLOID family.
Current Shin's Music fuzz product identified on the builder's official site; retain as a distinct named fuzz pending deeper historical chronology.
Japanese handmade fuzz associated with Nature Sound and its builder Kaoru Kunda; product evidence survives through Japanese player and catalog reporting.
Japanese Nature Sound drive model preserved from established Japanese gear documentation; retain as historical catalog evidence pending a stronger direct product page.
Zahnrad by nature sound handmade overdrive, the first Zahnrad release, built as a broadly usable 3-knob drive.
Japanese octave fuzz built around a Tone Machine concept with an added FLUX switch that expands the octave-fuzz behavior.
Japanese distortion associated with the Zahnrad line, combining a distortion role with a notably rougher fuzz-like character.
Korean dual-channel analog overdrive with separate channel gain, tone and level controls plus a crunch control on one channel.
Korean dual-channel overdrive using two sets of gain and tone controls and a raw-response control for broader low-end behavior.
Korean dual-channel analog distortion in the LiberaToe Gain Group, retained as a named product rather than a generic module.
Korean dual-channel distortion from the LiberaToe Gain Group, documented in current and Korean trade listings.
Korean dual-channel gain product combining overdrive and distortion functions in the LiberaToe platform ecosystem.
Korean dual-channel overdrive in the established LiberaToe Gain Group catalog.
Korean dual-channel distortion in the LiberaToe Gain Group catalog.
Korean dual-channel gain pedal combining distortion and overdrive functions within the modular LiberaToe line.
Chinese handmade two-transistor-style fuzz series with individually hand-painted enclosures and configurable germanium or silicon transistor options.
Chinese handmade fuzz inspired by 1960s fuzz tones, with a limited two-knob second-generation form and hand-painted finish.
Chinese handmade bass overdrive documented in the builder's current Reverb catalog.
